MODE 2-3: _+CX²

Quadratic regression with coefficients A, B, C and dual x̂ estimators.

keys
MODE→2→3

Parabolic / second-order experimental fits.

formula
y=A+Bx+Cx2

A parabola. You need at least three pairs. Recall A, B, and C from STAT → Reg (no r on this model type).

steps

Open this type

  1. MODE→2→3
  2. Clear or edit data in the Statistics Editor as needed
  3. AC, then SHIFT 1 (STAT) for Var / Reg / MinMax recalls
